g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Furniture contours are continuous silhouettes; coat opening joins neckline and hem with duplicate dots omitted. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry: coat and furniture surfaces lower grey, silhouettes and coat opening higher black; exterior and under-furniture spaces white/unraised. No measured height or material code.
